input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (ventures brief)
task: Deepen flagship 7 (photo-editing): DNG 1.6 ColorMatrix3 / triple-illuminant tables and IlluminantData
errors: Compiling Adobe DNG SDK functions in the scratchpad for a value-for-value comparison was denied by the auto-mode classifier (code from external); replaced with property tests and colour-science checks, and the gap is stated in the eval doc.
pyenv.py pytest numpy colour-science failed (PEP 668 / no matching interpreter); a scratchpad venv worked.
First preflight failed on post front matter lengths (description 162 > 160, seo_title 75 > 70); fixed.

doc_friction.issue: `run_venture_tests.py photo-editing` reports '0 suites run' and exit 0 for a Python venture; ventures/CLAUDE.md presents it as the venture test command, so a reader can think the tests passed when none ran. The real command is in photo-editing-ci.yml.

System Python in the container has a broken PIL (_imaging import error), so test_real_photo_calibration errors on every run; prior eval docs call it 'a failure that predates this change' without naming the cause.

deviations.why: Router's 'Start here' picked sales-agent; it had six slices land today on one queue (holiday presets), while photo-editing had a named BUILDABLE HERE item needing no outside input and no open PR.
deviations.result: Landed with tests and a colour-science check.

notes: Fluorescent synthetic scene: worst patch error 0.0005 with ColorMatrix3 vs 0.079 two-light. temperature_tint vs colour-science on 5,000 whites: 6e-15 relative / 5e-13 tint. Spectrum->xy on 20 CIE illuminants within 4.8e-5. Local: photo-editing unittest discover 624 tests, 1 pre-existing PIL error; ruff and mypy clean; venture preflight rerun after front matter fix.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: colour scientist reading the DNG 1.6 spec/SDK, implementing three-way blending, IlluminantData spectra and tests

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
